If Vanya has chosen a seat, Dima can choose one of the two adjacent seats. After their choice, there will be 8 seats left, which can be occupied by the remaining 8 people in 8! ways. Vanya can choose from 10 seats, after which Dima can choose one of 2 seats. In total, there are "favorable" seating arrangements of $10 \cdot 2 \cdot 8!$.
